one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Manufacturer of savoury bakery products - breads, buns, pizza bases and Kulcha - sold under the 'American Bakers' brand primarily in Uttar Pradesh.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Q&T Foods Limited manufactures, distributes, markets and sells savoury bakery products including breads (Milk, White, Multigrain, Brown), Kulcha, Pav, Burger Bun and Pizza Base under the 'American Bakers' brand. All products are made at a single in-house, ISO 22000:2018 and HACCP certified manufacturing facility in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, and sold through a dealer network of 50+ dealers primarily within Uttar Pradesh.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body: - **Bakery:** Milk Bread, White Bread, Multigrain Bread, Brown Bread, Kulcha, Pav, Burger Bun, Pizza Base

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Uttar Pradesh (99.32% of revenue, 9M ended Dec 31, 2025)
- Haryana (0.68%, 9M ended Dec 31, 2025)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Fully in-house manufacturing at the single Ghaziabad facility, with no outsourced/job-work production. Raw materials (flour, sugar, salt, oil and fats, yeast/fermenting agents, improvers, ascorbic acid, calcium propionate, acetic acid) are sourced entirely from local suppliers in Uttar Pradesh and nearby areas on a purchase-order basis, with no imports and no long-term supplier agreements. The Company does not operate retail stores; it sells wholesale to a network of 50+ dealers who resell to retailers - no forward integration into retail.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- EBITDA margin expanded from 2.25% (FY23) to 10.29% (FY25) to 12.02% (9M FY26) on operational efficiencies
- PAT margin rose from 0.13% (FY23) to 5.84% (FY25) to 7.11% (9M FY26)
- Revenue remains heavily concentrated in Uttar Pradesh (86-99% across FY23-9M FY26)
- Revenue declined 9M FY26 vs annualised run-rate (growth in revenue from operations was -10.56% for the 9-month period per KPI table)

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Focus on growth in higher-margin bakery segments by developing new products (pizza puffs, sub breads, footlong breads, croissants)
- Expand and widen customer base geographically and demographically
- Expand geographic reach beyond Uttar Pradesh into the larger domestic market via a scaled-down, low-price penetration strategy
- Continue to strive for cost efficiency and pursue economies of scale in procurement
- Attract, train and retain qualified technical/skilled personnel
- Focus on consistently meeting product quality standards

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: No new plant is disclosed; expansion is framed as deepening presence within Uttar Pradesh and entering new states/the larger domestic market with a low-price scale-down approach, funded in part by IPO proceeds earmarked for equipment/machinery capex at the existing single Ghaziabad facility.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Experience and leadership of Promoter Nishant Raj Gupta driving corporate strategy and business growth
- In-house, technology-driven manufacturing facility accredited with ISO 22000:2018 and HACCP
- Extensive and well-developed sales and distribution network of 50+ dealers
- Long-standing relationships with dealers supporting uninterrupted supply and pan-India retention
- Focus on quality and timely delivery of products

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Single, leased manufacturing facility — All production runs from one leased Ghaziabad facility with lease only through December 31, 2028; non-renewal or relocation would disrupt operations and add cost.
- Extreme geographic revenue concentration — 99.32% of 9M FY26 revenue came from Uttar Pradesh alone, exposing the company to regional demand or regulatory shocks.
- Outstanding litigation against Company and Promoters — 5 criminal and 6 GST proceedings against the Company (Rs. 51.11 lakhs) and 4 criminal and 6 GST proceedings against Promoters (Rs. 36.01 lakhs) are pending.
- No long-term dealer agreements — Sales run through 50+ dealers without long-term contracts, so relationships could be discontinued at will.
- Key-person dependence on Promoter — Corporate strategy and business growth are described as being driven predominantly by Promoter Nishant Raj Gupta.
- Limited shelf-life of products — Bakery products have a limited shelf life, requiring effective inventory management and timely dispatch to avoid losses.

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Utilise up to Rs. 442.21 lakhs (including GST) of Net Issue Proceeds to finance capital expenditure for purchase of equipment/machineries for the existing manufacturing facility.**
- **Utilise up to Rs. 750.00 lakhs of Net Issue Proceeds to part-finance working capital requirements.**
- **Utilise up to Rs. 675.00 lakhs of Net Issue Proceeds for repayment/pre-payment, in full or in part, of certain borrowings availed by the Company.**
- **Expand product portfolio into higher-margin bakery products such as pizza puffs, sub breads, footlong breads and croissants to improve profitability.**
- **Expand geographic reach beyond Uttar Pradesh into the larger domestic market via a scaled-down, low-price penetration strategy.**
- **Continue to focus on operational effectiveness and pursue economies of scale in procurement to reduce costs and improve margins.**
- **Attract, train and retain qualified personnel with the required skill set to support quality, timely delivery and cost control.**
- **Sole manufacturing facility operates on leased premises in Ghaziabad with the lease running only to December 31, 2028; non-renewal or termination could disrupt operations.**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Focus on growth in higher-margin bakery segments by developing new products (pizza puffs, sub breads, footlong breads, croissants)
- Expand and widen customer base geographically and demographically
- Expand geographic reach beyond Uttar Pradesh into the larger domestic market via a scaled-down, low-price penetration strategy
- Continue to strive for cost efficiency and pursue economies of scale in procurement
- Attract, train and retain qualified technical/skilled personnel
- Focus on consistently meeting product quality standards
